context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on government relations
purpose: Teach: ビラ/トピックス/ナショナリズム/ビジネスマン/プラザ/農林省/リーディング/請願

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔、私も農林省の局長たちと、よく駅前プラザで立ち話したよ。
lines.en: Long ago, I used to have standing conversations with ag-ministry bureau chiefs at the station plaza.
lines.style: Unhurried opening, as if gazing back. Warm, measured pace. Let the memory settle in the voice without pushing it. Slight weight on the specific image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今もそういう関係、大事なんでしょうね。
lines.en: Those kinds of relationships still matter, I imagine.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful. Genuine question underneath the deference. Meet his eyes without presumption. Soft landing on the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うん。請願書を出す前に、現場のビジネスマンと話を詰めるのが基本だ。
lines.en: Yes. Before you file anything, you sit down with the people actually doing the work and iron things out.
lines.style: Lighter now, almost conversational. Practical wisdom without lecturing. Steady rhythm. The weight is on the principle, not the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今週のトピックスにも、関連する話題が出ています。
lines.en: This week's news cycle actually touches on exactly this kind of thing.
lines.style: Engaged but not eager. Drawing the line from his experience to the present moment. Even pacing, alert listening underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ナショナリズム的な空気に流されるな。冷静なリーディングを心がけろ。
lines.en: Don't get swept up in the nationalist current. Keep your thinking sharp and your reading cool.
lines.style: Direct without hardness. The voice of someone who has seen movements rise and fall. No melodrama — just clarity. Conviction rests in steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。ビラの配り方も、丁寧に教える側を意識します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure the flyer work stays thoughtful — treat the people receiving them like I'm teaching, not just distributing.
lines.style: Sincere, taking the weight seriously. Not over-eager, but genuinely committed. Steady voice, moving from listening into action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Brief, warm, releasing. The approval settles something. Two words but they carry the full weight of the older man's faith.
